creative_execution_plan.main_idea: Show a long document physically compressing into a practical decision checklist across the carousel.
creative_execution_plan.focal_point: The changing relationship between a bulky stack of blank pages and a compact checklist card.
creative_execution_plan.media_rationale: No suitable real media exists, so generated still lifes make each instructional step concrete while keeping one coherent visual world.
creative_execution_plan.composition_direction: Use dark and light paper surfaces, asymmetrical paper arrangements, and increasingly ordered objects: volume first, extraction second, three cards third, finished checklist last.
creative_execution_plan.branding_treatment: Use a restrained KAGE-style editorial palette of ink, graphite, warm paper, off-white cards, and small red accents; keep the canonical logo clear in a corner.
creative_execution_plan.visual_treatment: Portrait editorial still lifes with tactile paper, hard edges, visible check marks, no readable text inside images, and recurring red decision marks that become more ordered from slide to slide.

visual_rhythm.arc: The sequence moves from tension between a long text and a short solution, through two concrete filtering steps, to a calm visual payoff.
visual_rhythm.repetition_note: The recurring paper-and-checkmark material deliberately evolves from messy volume to ordered checklist.
